name: inventory_maintenance_barrier
preconditionSql: SELECT to_regclass('public.inventory_stock_positions') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.variant_warehouse_cost_projection') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.batch_stock_positions') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.stock_reservations') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.inventory_movements') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.inventory_movement_lines') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.inventory_line_batches') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public.inventory_line_serials') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE proname='fn_inventory_maintenance_writer_barrier') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname LIKE 'bt_%__maintenance' AND NOT tgisinternal)=8 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls back all triggers and function. After success use a forward-only migration to modify the shared maintenance barrier.
